name: knowbase-x
description: KnowBase X — 基于 LangChain.js 的企业级 RAG 知识库平台

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/rag-engine build && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/agents build && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/server build && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/rag-engine build && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/agents build && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/agents test && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/rag-engine test && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/server test
scripts.test:watch: pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/agents test --watch && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/rag-engine test --watch && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/server test --watch
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d && pnpm --filter @knowbase-x/server test:integration && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml down -v
